fusions.name: Edict of the Deep
fusions.desc: A pointed command that deals 32 damage to an enemy up to 7 tiles away, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Raised Hand
fusions.desc: Every enemy within 3 tiles takes 10 damage and is stunned for 1 second.

fusions.name: Call to Court
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 12 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

fusions.name: Herald Crab
fusions.desc: A bonded herald crab fights beside you, striking enemies within 4.5 tiles for 4 damage every 1.5 seconds. Anything it strikes moves 15% slower for 3 seconds.
